Class TypedResourceDescription

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.rest.core.mapping.ResolvableResourceDescriptionSupport
org.springframework.data.rest.core.mapping.SimpleResourceDescription
org.springframework.data.rest.core.mapping.TypedResourceDescription
All Implemented Interfaces:
MessageSourceResolvable, ResourceDescription
public class TypedResourceDescription extends SimpleResourceDescription
SimpleResourceDescription 类还捕获了类型信息，以便能够生成合理的默认消息。该实现会对枚举类型进行处理，将可用值渲染为默认消息，并提供这些值作为消息解析的参数。
Author:
奥利弗·吉尔克
